resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the two-story cabin was removed in 1966; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1966. Both agree on the year, so the story reports both words.
The register text gives 1953 for the two-story cabin, but a photo caption on the same page gives 1951 as the last year for the 1920 cabin. The story reports both dates without choosing one.

sources.title: North Saddle Lookout Site (Former Fire Lookout Sites register)

notes_for_editor: Two register-family pages plus Wikipedia for the park. The firelookout.com header says R.I.P. 1920-1953 while its body says destroyed in 1966; the body was used. The 1913 camp was not a lookout cab, so it is coded other. Wikipedia is a lead, not a primary source; the trail and park facts should be checked against an Oregon Parks page before publishing. The Wikipedia coordinates are about 300 m from the brief's coordinates, consistent with the same peak. Access level 'public' rests on the park's listed type, not on a rule for the lookout site itself.
